info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Marialit Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the addition of detailed catalog entries for the Marialit Recliner product. With this endpoint, businesses can enhance their inventory management by creating comprehensive and structured details about the Marialit Recliner. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory systems that aim to provide customers with complete product information. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure that accurate product data is consistently integrated into their applications, improving user experience and satisfaction.

post.summary: Create new details for a Marialit recliner.
